title: 08 — Cleanup And Handoff (Atoms)
system_instructions: You are working on step 08 of the Atoms pipeline in @vsk/ui-kit.
Communicate with the human developer/designer in Russian (RU), but keep code identifiers, file paths, shell commands, and other technical literals in English.
goal: Move final assets into permanent locations, summarize changes, and clean temporary context for the atom.

roles.agent: Ensure assets and code are in permanent locations and clean up temp context.
roles.developer: Review final file list and confirm cleanup.
roles.designer: Optionally sign off on final design references.

inputs_expected: Final stories, assets, and optional wrapper component for the atom.

actions.description: Confirm that all required assets and exports for the atom are in permanent locations.
human_checklist: Все финальные ассеты и истории находятся в ожидаемых путях?
Нет ли временных файлов в репозитории (сырые SVG/CSS из llm_current_task_context)?
Описания и Design вкладка соответствуют согласованному дизайну?

actions.description: Clean the temp folder for this atom, leaving only agreed artifacts if any.
human_checklist: Папка `llm_current_task_context/atoms/<atom-name>/` очищена (или остались только осознанно нужные файлы)?
DONE-файл создан для явной фиксации завершения работы по этому атому?

acceptance_criteria: All permanent assets and code paths are confirmed.
Temp context for the atom is cleaned or minimized and marked DONE.
List of changed/created repository paths is ready for PR description.
next_step_prompt: No further steps for this atom; ready for PR and review.
